title: Compatible cocone legs across prime localization
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, p a prime, A = R_p [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], K a field, and χ : κ_R(p) → K and ψ : κ_A(q) → K [def-weil-residue-field]. For cocones η and θ of the pointed étale ring diagrams [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples] with common vertex V, define compatibility to mean: for every global triple s, local triple t, and ring map β : s.B → t.B that respects the R-structure maps and the two pointings into K, β followed by θ_t equals η_s.
